source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: AddressBookAccountSelect builds buttons for the new account state and uses replaceChildren after the loop. It sets the account username as the submitted value, keeps full-name/email text literal and passes count arguments to Fluent. Tests directly check button replacement, disabled state, literal values and localization arguments; they do not prove translated text or performance. The batching request was nonblocking and applied.
title: Replace account-option state without accumulating old buttons
